about_the_game:
An unknown city is under siege. An intense surge of anomaly activity is taking hold, and the threats are no longer subtle. The Supernatural Investigation Agency (S.I.A.) recognizes the escalating danger and dispatches a squad from Critical Containment Threat Verification (C.C.T.V.) Division. You as the captain leading the team were sent to investigate, and discovered the horrifying truth: malevolent entities are directly responsible for the chaos.

Your mission is two-fold: Monitor live surveillance feeds and report anomalies, and then face the dangerous entities to neutralize the threat. Scour every room and don't miss a thing—or your life, and the lives of your squad, will be lost.

Features:

  •  Surveillance Horror: Scour CCTV feeds in real-time, identifying subtle anomalies that grow increasingly disturbing.

  • Unique Locations: Multiple locations with distinct environments and unique anomalies to track.

  • Escalating Difficulty: Different difficulties per level where anomalies become more active and aggressive, testing your vigilance.

  • Dangerous Entities: Confront unique and dangerous entities in each location. Every entity has its own behaviour, requiring different approach on how to handle them.

  • Secrets and Lore: Unlock secrets by clearing levels or performing specific actions during gameplay.

content_descriptors.notes: This is a horror game that features blood and gore, and a few jumpscares

  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support

short_description: Play as one of the Squad Captain from C.C.T.V division and monitor live surveillance feeds and neutralize anomalies by reporting them, including dangerous entities.
